# Pigi Finance MCP - DeFi Vault Intelligence

MCP server exposing DeFi vault intelligence for AI agents: 2,000+ vaults across 25+ EVM chains.

## Capability surface

- Vault discovery and metrics across 25+ EVM chains
- OAuth 2.0 with wallet authentication
- Endpoint verified live at catalog time (401 auth-gated, which is the expected response for an authenticated MCP endpoint)

## Auth

OAuth 2.0 with wallet auth. A 401 from an unauthenticated client is expected and does not mean the endpoint is down.

## Status

Catalogued from vendor documentation and endpoint verification. Deep-dive page pending further capability confirmation.
